facts.did: 乘骡车沿热尘道路向北，花了大半天到达 Herculaneum 的 Lucius 别墅
facts.anchor: rode up the coast in the back of a mule-drawn cart

facts.did: 指着一座巨大的 tomb（Flavia 为亡夫所建），念出刻在墓侧的话 His head could not hold all his ideas.，说 Flavia 明知亡夫的头脑连一个想法都装不下
facts.anchor: His head could not hold all his ideas.

facts.who: Lucius 的一名被奴役仆役
facts.did: （一个剃发的男子）把众人领到私人浴场旁的房间，他们纷纷下水洗去一天的汗与尘
facts.anchor: showed them to some rooms next to a private bath

facts.did: 在纯黑墙面的藏书室取下卷轴在桌上展开，认出 Socrates 与 Epicurus（接连几卷都是 Epicurus），说「我觉得他喜欢 Epicurus」
facts.anchor: I’m getting the idea that he likes Epicurus.

facts.did: 为 Peristyle 解释书写：拉丁与希腊文是把声音振动转为符号（非洲另有把整词变成符号的写法），可以拼读；Peristyle 快速记住罗马字母表试读 Epicurus，但读得很不顺
facts.anchor: a way of converting sound vibrations into symbols

facts.did: 先重新配置 suit 的输出、把 Murtis 的身体感受送到自己的敏感器官，再把 tentacle 伸向 Murtis 背部那束由钙质管保护的 director cells 发送信息
facts.anchor: tentacle toward the thick trunk of director cells in Murtis’s back

facts.did: 事后把这次交合生成的全部数据从 galaxysuit 中清除，且绝不把它存进任何笔记本（无论秘密与否）
facts.anchor: purged all the data generated by their encounter

facts.did: 说该回派对去了、要确认 Hercules 与 Curly 没惹上麻烦；两人整理衣物、把卷轴放回架上回到花园，Peristyle 把 suit 恢复成常规配置
facts.anchor: make sure Hercules and Curly aren’t getting into trouble

relations.relation: Hercules 与他的男友（自称 Curly）是恋人
relations.anchor: Hercules and his boyfriend, who introduced himself as Curly

relations.relation: Flavia 在丈夫死时为他建了那座巨大 tomb
relations.anchor: Flavia built that when her husband died.

relations.relation: Peristyle 说自己觉得好是因为「我这么喜欢你」，Murtis 回应「我也喜欢你」
relations.anchor: I think it’s because I like you so much.

relations.relation: Lucius 正在 triclinium 里与 senators 用餐，之后才会出来
relations.anchor: Lucius was inside dining with senators

numbers.fact: 前往 Lucius 别墅花了当天大部分时间
numbers.anchor: It took most of the day to get to

numbers.fact: 别墅里两尊青铜的青年运动员裸像
numbers.anchor: Burnished in bronze were two young athletes

numbers.fact: 过去一周 Peristyle 都在 taberna 里帮忙
numbers.anchor: For the past week, she had been helping in the taberna

numbers.fact: 黑色藏书室内有两张形似工作台的桌子
numbers.anchor: were two desks, roughly the shape of workstations
